records.source: It's not a good time of year for a diet...$s
records.translation: Hindi magandang panahon para magdiyeta...$s

records.source: Good afternoon, @. Happy Feasting.
records.translation: Magandang hapon, @. Maligayang Piging.

records.source: I'm thankful for my guitar and my skateboard. Oh, and my family I guess.
records.translation: Nagpapasalamat ako sa gitara at skateboard ko. Oh, at sa pamilya ko rin siguro.

records.source: Gus was just telling me about his artisan candy canes. *yawn*$u#$e#I think he had too much cinnamon nog.
records.translation: Ikinukuwento sa akin ni Gus ang mga gawang-kamay niyang baston na kendi. *hikab*$u#$e#Sa tingin ko, naparami ang nainom niyang eggnog na may kanela.

records.source: Welcome to the Feast of the Winter Star!$h
records.translation: Maligayang pagdating sa Piging ng Bituin ng Taglamig!$h

records.source: Why, hello @. It's chilly, isn't it?
records.translation: Aba, kumusta, @. Malamig, hindi ba?

records.source: It's a fine art, making candy canes. You've really got to search far and wide for the best ingredients. They aren't easy to come by these days!$h#$e#I usually use Fern Island Ringfruit for my premier canes, you know. You can't beat that bright red coloring... And it's all natural!#$e#Oh, you want to know the secret to my deluxe double-canes? Okay, but you've got to promise absolute secrecy. *whisper* It's a drop of vanilla in the white candy to complement the cherry flavor.$h#$e#Of course, peppermint candy canes are the standard, and I always make a healthy batch of those as well.#$e#Hey, you look like you're falling asleep. Are you okay?$s
records.translation: Isang pinong sining ang paggawa ng mga baston na kendi. Kailangan mo talagang maghanap sa lahat ng dako para sa pinakamahuhusay na sangkap. Hindi madaling makita ang mga iyon ngayon!$h#$e#Karaniwan kong ginagamit ang Fern Island Ringfruit para sa pinakamahuhusay kong baston. Walang tatalo sa matingkad na pulang kulay niyon... At likas ang lahat!#$e#Oh, gusto mong malaman ang lihim ng de-lukseng dobleng baston ko? Sige, pero kailangan mong ipangako ang ganap na paglilihim. *bulong* Isang patak ng banilya sa puting kendi para bumagay sa lasang seresa.$h#$e#Siyempre, pamantayan ang mga baston na kendi na menta, at lagi rin akong gumagawa ng marami niyon.#$e#Hoy, mukhang nakakatulog ka na. Ayos ka lang ba?$s

records.source: $y 'Do you want to hear the Legend of the Winter Star?_Yes_In the night sky of winter, there is a bright star only visible from this valley. No one knows why this is... but in times of old people would come from far and wide to see it.*They believed that anyone who laid eyes on the Winter Star would be blessed with good fortune. Some even claim that the mysterious fruit known as =Stardrop is connected to the Winter Star in some way._No thanks_Suit yourself.'
records.translation: $y 'Gusto mo bang marinig ang Alamat ng Bituin ng Taglamig?_Oo_Sa kalangitan ng taglamig, may maliwanag na bituing makikita lamang mula sa lambak na ito. Walang nakaaalam kung bakit... pero noong unang panahon, nagmumula pa sa malalayong lugar ang mga tao para makita iyon.*Naniniwala silang pagpapalain ng magandang kapalaran ang sinumang makakita sa Bituin ng Taglamig. Sinasabi pa ng ilan na may kaugnayan dito ang mahiwagang prutas na kilala bilang =Patak-Bituin._Hindi, salamat_Ikaw ang bahala.'

records.source: Ah, the mysterious Winter Star. One of the reasons I chose this valley as the location for my... research.
records.translation: Ah, ang mahiwagang Bituin ng Taglamig. Isa sa mga dahilan kung bakit pinili ko ang lambak na ito bilang lugar ng aking... pananaliksik.

records.source: I'm thankful there were no medical emergencies this year!
records.translation: Nagpapasalamat akong walang emerhensiyang medikal ngayong taon!

records.source: I heard it's raining back home. Is that why you came here?$h#$e#I kind of miss the rain, actually...$s
records.translation: Narinig kong umuulan sa inyo. Iyon ba ang dahilan kung bakit ka pumunta rito?$h#$e#Sa totoo lang, medyo hinahanap-hanap ko rin ang ulan...$s

records.source: Ohh! Presents!$h
records.translation: Ohh! Mga regalo!$h

records.source: Can we open presents now?!
records.translation: Maaari na ba nating buksan ang mga regalo?!

records.source: Hey, good afternoon.
records.translation: Hoy, magandang hapon.

records.source: Linus feels uncomfortable about joining in, so I'm going to keep him company.#$e#We'll have our own little feast... mashed winter root and spice berry fish!$h
records.translation: Hindi komportable si Linus na sumali, kaya sasamahan ko siya.#$e#Magkakaroon kami ng sarili naming munting piging... dinurog na Ugat ng Taglamig at isdang may Mabangong Bunga!$h

records.source: Brr... It's cold! I wanna get back under the covers...
records.translation: Brr... Ang lamig! Gusto ko nang bumalik sa ilalim ng mga kumot...

records.source: Elliott's drinking too much cider again...$7#$e#I'll come meet you at the table when I can find an exit... I'm starving!
records.translation: Napararami na naman ang cider na iniinom ni Elliott...$7#$e#Susundan kita sa hapag kapag nakahanap ako ng labasan... Gutom na gutom ako!

records.source: I'm thankful to have a loving family and you in my life...$0
records.translation: Nagpapasalamat akong mayroon akong mapagmahal na pamilya at kasama kita sa buhay ko...$0

records.source: I hope everyone likes my powdermelon crisp...$h
records.translation: Sana magustuhan ng lahat ang malutong na Melong May Pulbos na ginawa ko...$h

records.source: When I count all the good things in my life, I feel like I've been blessed by the Winter Star.
records.translation: Kapag binibilang ko ang lahat ng mabubuting bagay sa buhay ko, pakiramdam ko ay pinagpala ako ng Bituin ng Taglamig.

records.source: When Haley and I were kids, we always used to decorate cookies at this festival.#$b#We should do it sometime! You can't let good traditions die out.$h
records.translation: Noong mga bata pa kami ni Haley, lagi kaming nagdedekorasyon ng mga biskwit sa pistang ito.#$b#Dapat natin itong gawin minsan! Hindi dapat hayaang mamatay ang magagandang tradisyon.$h

records.source: Hey... don't worry, you don't need to get me anything.$h#$e#I'm just happy to wake up next to you every morning... what else could a guy ask for?$l
records.translation: Hoy... huwag kang mag-alala, hindi mo kailangang regaluhan ako.$h#$e#Masaya na akong gumising sa tabi mo bawat umaga... ano pa ang mahihiling ng isang lalaki?$l

records.source: It's kinda fun watching everyone unwrap their presents... seeing their reactions.$h#$e#Oh yeah, I got you something. I'll uhh... show you when we get back to the farmhouse!$10
records.translation: Medyo masayang panoorin ang lahat habang binubuksan nila ang mga regalo... at makita ang mga reaksiyon nila.$h#$e#Oh, oo, may inihanda ako para sa iyo. Uhh... ipapakita ko sa iyo pagbalik natin sa Bahay-Bukid!$10

records.source: Let me know if you get cold. I'll lend you my jacket.$0
records.translation: Sabihin mo kung lalamigin ka. Pahihiramin kita ng dyaket ko.$0

records.source: There's a lot I'm thankful for, like my clinic, the good health of my patients...#$b#But ultimately, I'm most thankful for the life we're building together...$l
records.translation: Marami akong ipinagpapasalamat, gaya ng klinika ko at mabuting kalusugan ng mga pasyente ko...#$b#Pero higit sa lahat, lubos akong nagpapasalamat sa buhay na binubuo natin nang magkasama...$l

records.source: My dear, I require nothing at all on this day... you are already the greatest gift a man could hope for.$h
records.translation: Mahal ko, wala akong kailangan sa araw na ito... ikaw na ang pinakadakilang regalong maaaring hilingin ng isang lalaki.$h

records.source: What am I thankful for?#$b#....uh...$3#$b#I'm thankful... that you pulled me out of the gutter. And showed me that life is worth living.$6
records.translation: Ano ang ipinagpapasalamat ko?#$b#....uh...$3#$b#Nagpapasalamat ako... na iniahon mo ako sa lusak. At ipinakita mong may saysay ang buhay.$6

records.source: I wonder which present is mine...$0#$e#I hope it's the big box!$h
records.translation: Alin kaya sa mga regalo ang akin...$0#$e#Sana ang malaking kahon!$h

records.source: Welp... Husband got me a new power saw this year...$6#$b#He must've forgotten that he got me the same thing two years ago!$6
records.translation: Hay... Binigyan ako ng asawa ko ng bagong de-kuryenteng lagari ngayong taon...$6#$b#Siguradong nakalimutan niyang iyon din ang ibinigay niya sa akin dalawang taon na ang nakararaan!$6
